description:
There is a case in a lock-up off the Yards. The Quartermaster wants it at the Blind by morning, and she wants it carried there in a hand rather than sent on any wire in this city.

It is not heavy. It is not fastened either, which she mentions on the way past and does not come back to.

"Straight through," she says. "If it goes wrong, put it down and walk. It is worth less than you are, and I will only say that once."
name: Carry It Back

objectives.desc: Collect the case from the lock-up off the Yards.
emotes: {who} finds the lock-up by its number, and the number by counting, because none of them are lit.
{who} lifts the case and finds the catch is not fastened.
{who} spends about four seconds deciding, and then walks.

objectives.desc: Carry the case back to the Blind.
emotes: {who} takes the long way round the market rather than the short way through it.
{who} changes hands at the bridge and keeps going.
{who} puts the case on the counter with the catch exactly as it was.
